policySummary: Students must connect to 'Campus-Secure' using WPA2-Enterprise with valid university credentials. 'Campus-Guest' is throttled and restricted to public web access.
verifiedSteps: Open your device Wi-Fi settings and choose 'Forget Network' for 'Campus-Secure'.
Connect temporarily to 'Campus-Guest' and navigate to https://wifi.campus.edu/cert to download the updated 2026 security certificate.
Reconnect to 'Campus-Secure', entering your full student email (e.g. username@campus.edu) and current active password.

If experiencing frequent drops on Main Library Floor 2: AP-LIB-2B is currently undergoing antenna balancing; move closer to the East Study Bay or connect via wired Ethernet at the library study carrels.

policySummary: Student passwords expire every 180 days. Accounts enter an automated 30-minute security lockout after 5 consecutive incorrect attempts.
verifiedSteps: Visit https://id.campus.edu/recovery in a private or incognito browsing window to eliminate stale cookies.
Select 'Self-Service Password Reset' and verify your identity via SMS code sent to your registered emergency mobile number.
If your Duo MFA prompt times out or fails to push, select 'Other Options' on the login screen and request a 6-digit SMS verification code.
If your account status indicates an administrative hold, contact the Identity Management desk at accounts@campus.edu with your Student ID.

policySummary: Classroom lecterns require pressing 'System On' before video output can synchronize. Urgent AV calls during scheduled lectures receive priority radio dispatch.
verifiedSteps: Check the lectern control touch panel: ensure the power toggle displays a steady green 'Active' status.
Press and hold 'Source Select' for 2 seconds, then toggle explicitly to 'Lectern HDMI' or 'Lectern USB-C' matching your connected cable.
On Windows press [Win + P] and verify display mode is set to 'Duplicate'. On macOS verify Displays > Mirror Displays.
If the projector lamp indicator flashes amber or displays no lamp activity, dial classroom emergency extension ext. 4358 (DISP) for an immediate 10-minute dispatch technician.

policySummary: Physical repairs are prioritized by safety impact. Active water leaks, exposed electrical wiring, and broken locks are dispatched with Emergency SLA (under 1 hour).
verifiedSteps: Note the exact building name, wing, room number, or closest structural pillar.
If water is pooling near electrical fixtures or causing slip hazards, do not touch the fixture and place safety signage if available.
Submit an issue report with the exact location description so the maintenance crew can route the appropriate plumbing/electrical trade.
For after-hours emergency flooding or hazards, call Facilities 24/7 hotline at ext. 2222 immediately.

policySummary: Balances exceeding $250 trigger a registration hold. Students may enroll in an emergency 3-month deferred payment plan before the census date.
verifiedSteps: Log into Student Portal > My Finance > Account Ledger to inspect specific itemized charges.
If you have pending financial aid or scholarships awaiting disbursement, check the 'Anticipated Aid' tab to confirm documentation is complete.
To request a temporary hold release for course enrollment, submit the Financial Aid Deferment Form FA-20 to the Bursar.
Students experiencing sudden hardship can request an Emergency Emergency Loan voucher through the Student Finance Office.

policySummary: Prerequisite waivers require explicit electronic authorization from both the course instructor and department chair prior to the Add/Drop deadline.
verifiedSteps: Check your Degree Works audit to verify prerequisite catalog course equivalencies.
Download the 'Electronic Prerequisite Override Petition' from the Academic Advising portal.
Attach your unofficial transcript highlighting completed prerequisite coursework.
Submit the petition directly to advising@campus.edu or schedule a 15-minute express appointment with your assigned faculty advisor.
